title: Exploring Daily Emotional Well-Being through Personalized Data Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2611.24342v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This project analysed daily emotional well-being from a personalized perspective using records of emotional states and contextual information derived from daily life. It was based on the idea that well-being is not a fixed value, but varies from day to day, and can be better understood in relation to individual context and behaviour. The work is framed within the field of Data Science and focuses on emotional states at an individual level. The project focused on constructing an integrated daily dataset from multiple personal data sources and analysing emotional states. The distributions of emotional variables, their temporal evolution and the differences between users were studied, together with their variability over time. Personality and well-being questionnaires were also incorporated as stable references to better contextualize daily emotional results. translated_title: 通过个性化数据分析探索日常情绪幸福感
translated_abstract: 该项目从个性化视角出发，利用源自日常生活的情绪状态记录及情境信息来分析每日情绪幸福感。项目基于这样一种理念：幸福感并非固定不变的数值，而是逐日波动的，只有结合个体的情境与行为才能被更好地理解。这项工作归属于数据科学领域，聚焦于个体层面的情绪状态。项目重点在于从多个个人数据源构建一个整合的每日数据集并对情绪状态进行分析，研究了情绪变量的分布、其随时间的演变、用户之间的差异以及情绪随时间的波动性。此外，项目还引入了人格与幸福感问卷作为稳定的参照基准，以便更好地对每日情绪分析结果进行情境化解读。在此基础上，项目通过比较（相似性）……开发了一种简单的个性化推荐方法。
tldr: 该项目通过整合多源个人数据构建每日情绪数据集，结合人格与幸福感问卷对个体日常情绪状态及其时间变化进行个性化分析，并据此提出了一种简单的个性化情绪推荐方法。
en_tdlr: This project constructs an integrated daily dataset from multiple personal data sources to analyze individual-level daily emotional states and their temporal variability, contextualized with personality and well-being questionnaires, and develops a simple personalized recommendation approach.
